newsitem.title: USA: Community First files $60 mln offering.
newsitem.headline: Community First files $60 mln offering.

text.p: Community First Bankshares Inc said it registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission a proposed offering of $60 million of Cumulative Capital Securities by CFB Capital I, a Delaware business trust subsidiary of Community First.
Proceeds from the offering to CFB Capital will be used to purchase a like amount of Junior Subordinated Debentures of Community First, the company said in a statement.
Community First will use the net proceeds from the issuance of the Junior Subordinated Debentures for general corporate purposes including acquisitions, financing and debt.
The offering will be made through Piper Jaffray Inc and Dain Bosworth Inc.
Community First is a multi-bank holding company that operates banks and bank branches in 79 communities in Colorado, Iowa, Minnesota, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota and Wisconsin.
